question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Lovely
solution:
The correct answer is **"Lousy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Lovely"** means attractive or beautiful. (सुंदर या आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example**: *This is a **lovely**__ room.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of **Lovely** is **Lousy**.
 
• **"Lousy"** means bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We had **lousy**__ weather on Sunday.*
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Pretty **means attractive in a delicate or graceful way. (दिखने या सुनने में अच्‍छा और आकर्षक)
 
• **Option 2: Attractive** means pleasing or appealing to the senses. (दिलचस्‍प, मोहक; रुचिकर)
 
• **Option 3: Hunky** means strong, muscular, and attractive in a manly way. (मर्दाना तरीके से मजबूत, मांसल और आकर्षक)
